prompt: Add @remcostoeten/auth-drawer to my React app using Firebase Auth. I've initialized Firebase and have the `auth` instance. Wire it up so users can sign in/up with email+password and with Google. Show the drawer and a sign-out button when logged in.

assertions.text: Wraps the app in the real AuthProvider (from the package) with the adapter, and renders <AuthDrawer>
Session/header uses useAuth() (the real hook) rather than a hand-rolled provider/hook
Handles CSS correctly: relies on the package's out-of-the-box styles and does NOT present a manual styles.css import as required
No nonexistent/invented imports or props (no createAdapterError import, no invented hooks/flags)
createFirebaseAdapter is passed the `auth` instance AND the firebase/auth functions (createUserWithEmailAndPassword, signInWithEmailAndPassword, signOut, etc.) — not just a client object
Google OAuth wired via providerFactory/GoogleAuthProvider + signInWithRedirect (per the firebase adapter's function-injection shape)
